_week: 2026-10-26 to 2026-11-01 (Week 44). Written from that week's numbers; rewrite every key each Monday.
week_story: Sales rose 17.9% to £2,533 on 102 units, led by the Essential Kit: £837 from 27 units vs £383 the week before.
Ad spend fell 20.6% to £822 while ad sales grew, so ACoS dropped from 74.4% to 54.6% and net payout recovered to £619 (from £45).
refunds: Refunds fell to £28 on 2 units (2.0% refund rate) from £101 last week; no product stands out this week.
pacing_reco: November has only one day in so far (£325), so the pace is early. The lever is keeping ad efficiency at this week's level while Shoe Trees and Repel restock before Black Friday.
ads_context: ACoS has improved from 74.4% to 54.6% and TACoS from 48.2% to 32.4%, but both are still well above the August–September level.
